build_face_enhancer_load_model: build a GPEN-BFR-256 face enhancer by loading the ONNX model from disk or downloading it automatically
enhance_face_restoration: enhance a face in a frame using the GPEN-BFR-256 ONNX model at 256x256 resolution
process_image_enhancement: process a single target image to detect and enhance the face, saving the result to an output path
process_video_faces: process all extracted frames of a video to detect and enhance faces in each frame sequentially
test_pre_check_validation: test pre_check and pre_start validation functions to verify model availability and target path validity
